change: four seed lines amended (primary definition, secondary definition, the dependency sentence of section 4, the storing-element restriction); worked examples unchanged

edits.from: At module level, the primary assets are the structural references of the conceptual assets. These are what the executor reports.
edits.to: At module level, the primary assets are the structural references of the conceptual assets. These are what the executor reports. An element whose own value is a state, setting or decision that the module's behavior depends on realizes that concept itself; it is primary even though it also influences other values.

edits.from: or an internal signal or register that influences a primary asset or could violate its security objective. The executor never reports secondary assets
edits.to: or an internal signal or register that influences a primary asset or could violate its security objective without holding a state, setting or decision of its own. A register that holds the value only while moving it from where it enters the module to where it leaves carries that value; it is secondary. The executor never reports secondary assets

edits.from: Do not turn a dependency into a primary asset merely because corrupting it could affect an Established concept.
edits.to: Do not turn a dependency into a primary asset merely because corrupting it could affect an Established concept. A state, setting or decision element is not a mere dependency of the values it influences: it realizes its own concept.

edits.from: - A storing element remains a realization point even when it captures unchanged data.
edits.to: - A storing element remains a realization point even when it captures unchanged data, unless it holds the value only while moving it from where it enters the module to where it leaves; such a register carries the value.
